messages:
jamal: quick repro — after ~16k tokens the model output stutters and repeats an earlier phrase. Happens only when we flip quant profile mid-request (int4g -> int8fallback). Dumped logs and small repro below.

jamal: repro command:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV" -d '{"model":"rwd-3b-open","quant":"int4g","switch_after":16000, "prompt":"<long-doc>"}' https://dev.api.redwood/run
```

sasha: ugh, saw similar in canary. any KV cache mismatch in index math? :thinking:

maria: got a trace. KV write offset jumps by 4 for even shard ids when seq > 16384. attaching slice:
```
KV_IDX_INC shard=2 old=16380 new=16384
KV_IDX_INC shard=2 old=16384 new=16388 <-- should be 16385
```

devon: that + wrap arithmetic with rope_scale renormalization could explain the repeat. i'll try a quick patch to clamp increments.

jamal: also note it only repros under mixed-quant path; pure int8/int16 runs clean.

sasha: can you run with `ENABLE_ROPE_SAFE_MODE=1`? if that clears, it points to phase rescaling bug.

maria: ran with safe mode on - no repro after 50k tokens. interesting.

devon: bisecting now between kernel versions: nvfuser-kernel-2026-03 vs nvfuser-kernel-2026-01. putting a small perf hit but helps confirm.

ci-bot: Canary deploy rwd/kv-fix-branch completed on dev-k8s (build 3124). :white_check_mark:

jamal: thanks. i'll collect eval traces and open a minimal unit test for the stride arithmetic. cc @sasha @maria @devon :thumbsup:
